<?php
function warningHomoTail($severityHomoTail, $messageHomoTail) {
    global $xHomoTail, $countHomoTail;
    ++$countHomoTail;
    echo 'warning:', $countHomoTail, ':', $messageHomoTail, '|';
    $xHomoTail = 3.5;
    if ($countHomoTail === 2) { $xHomoTail = 4.5; }
    return true;
}
function valueHomoTail(int $aHomoTail, int $bHomoTail = 7, int $cHomoTail = 11) {
    echo 'value-body:', $aHomoTail, ':', $bHomoTail, ':', $cHomoTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xHomoTail'], '|';
    return $cHomoTail;
}
function referenceHomoTail(int &$aHomoTail, int &$bHomoTail = 7, int &$cHomoTail = 11) {
    echo 'reference-body:', $aHomoTail, ':', $bHomoTail, ':', $cHomoTail, ':', $GLOBALS['xHomoTail'], '|';
    return $cHomoTail;
}
set_error_handler('warningHomoTail');
$xHomoTail = 2;
$countHomoTail = 0;
valueHomoTail($xHomoTail);
referenceHomoTail($xHomoTail);
valueHomoTail(cHomoTail: $xHomoTail, aHomoTail: $xHomoTail);
referenceHomoTail(cHomoTail: $xHomoTail, aHomoTail: $xHomoTail);
try { valueHomoTail(bHomoTail: $xHomoTail); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtHomoTail) { echo 'value-required:', $xHomoTail, '|'; }
try { referenceHomoTail(cHomoTail: $xHomoTail); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtHomoTail) { echo 'reference-required:', $xHomoTail, '|'; }
try { valueHomoTail(); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtHomoTail) { echo 'value-empty:', $xHomoTail, '|'; }
try { referenceHomoTail(); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caughtHomoTail) { echo 'reference-empty:', $xHomoTail, '|'; }
purpose: Homogeneous VAL and REF exact-int headers keep literal defaults quiet, named optional holes fill normally, and required-hole/empty-call errors retain their existing priority.
